title: Mammalian cell-culture passage
summary: Split adherent mammalian cells before they overgrow. Standard 1:5 to 1:20 split depending on line.
hazardsMd: Mammalian cells with potential adventitious agents = BSL-2. All work inside the BSC. Spent media contains FBS (potentially pathogenic) — autoclave or bleach before disposal.
contentUndergrad:
## When to passage
Check under the microscope: at 80-90% confluence (cells touching but not piled). Past confluence cells contact-inhibit and senesce. Track passage number; primary cells run out around p10-15.

steps.title: Inspect under microscope
steps.instructionMd: Confirm cells are 80-90% confluent, healthy morphology, no contamination. Floating debris or rod-shaped contaminants in the media = STOP and report.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Contaminated flasks must be autoclaved, not poured down the drain.
steps.verificationMd: Cells visibly attached, flat morphology, characteristic shape for the line. No floaters, no cloudy media.

steps.title: Aspirate media, wash
steps.instructionMd: In BSC: aspirate spent media to a vacuum trap with 10% bleach. Add 5 mL pre-warmed PBS, rock gently, aspirate.
steps.verificationMd: Cells stay attached; PBS wash takes off the FBS without lifting cells.

steps.title: Trypsinize
steps.instructionMd: Add 1 mL trypsin-EDTA to T25 (3 mL to T75). Tilt to coat. Incubate 37 °C / 3-5 min. Tap flask sharply; under microscope cells should round up and slough off.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Over-trypsinizing damages membranes. Watch the timer.
steps.verificationMd: Cells visibly detached and floating in single suspension under the microscope.

steps.title: Quench and split
steps.instructionMd: Add 4 mL fresh media to neutralize trypsin. Pipette up and down 3-4× to break clumps. Transfer the calculated split fraction to a new flask with 5 mL fresh media.
steps.verificationMd: Cell suspension uniform, no large clumps. New flask volume covers the bottom uniformly.

steps.title: Return to incubator
steps.instructionMd: Label new flask with line, date, passage number. Place in incubator, rocked gently to distribute evenly. Check confluence the next day.
steps.verificationMd: Flask label complete and legible. Cells in incubator. Lab notebook entry filed (split ratio, passage number).
